CREATE TABLE credit_account_limits (
                account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES uta_accounts(account_id),
                asset TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_assets(asset), units TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(account_id,asset))
CREATE TABLE credit_asset_limits (asset TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES ledger_assets(asset), units TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE credit_commands (
                scope TEXT NOT NULL, command_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL,
                asset TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_assets(asset), amount TEXT NOT NULL,
                source_reference TEXT, result TEXT NOT NULL,
                journal_event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES ledger_events(event_id),
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(scope,command_id))
CREATE TABLE credit_schema (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), version INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE ledger_assets (
        asset TEXT PRIMARY KEY, scale INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (scale BETWEEN 0 AND 18))

CREATE TABLE ledger_balances (
        account TEXT NOT NULL, asset TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_assets(asset),
        units TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (account, asset))

CREATE TABLE ledger_events (
        sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, previous_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        event_hash TEXT NOT NULL, sealed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sealed IN (0, 1)))

CREATE TABLE ledger_postings (
        sequence INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_events(sequence),
        ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0), account TEXT NOT NULL,
        asset TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_assets(asset), units TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (sequence, ordinal))

CREATE TABLE ledger_schema (
        singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
        version INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE router_shard_identity (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), shard INTEGER NOT NULL, layout_hash TEXT NOT NULL, initialized INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(initialized IN (0,1)))
CREATE TABLE uta_accounts (account_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version >= 0))

CREATE TABLE uta_audit_capability (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),format INTEGER NOT NULL,enabled_at TEXT NOT NULL,legacy_event_watermark INTEGER NOT NULL,legacy_order_count INTEGER NOT NULL,legacy_fill_count INTEGER NOT NULL,gaps TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE uta_authority (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('exchange','research')))
CREATE TABLE uta_code_artifacts (artifact_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,manifest TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE uta_command_config (
                singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), format INTEGER NOT NULL,
                queue_capacity INTEGER NOT NULL, cancel_reserve INTEGER NOT NULL, market_capacity INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE uta_command_inbox (
                sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, command_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                account_id TEXT, kind TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('PENDING','SUCCEEDED','REJECTED','QUARANTINED')),
                result TEXT, error TEXT, enqueued_at TEXT NOT NULL, completed_at TEXT,
                attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_error TEXT, next_attempt_at TEXT)
CREATE TABLE uta_config (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE uta_deposits (
                account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES uta_accounts(account_id), event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                asset TEXT NOT NULL, amount TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(account_id,event_id))

CREATE TABLE uta_events (
                sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                account_id TEXT, payload TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE uta_fills (
                account_id TEXT NOT NULL, fill_id TEXT NOT NULL, order_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                quantity TEXT NOT NULL, price TEXT NOT NULL, realized_pnl TEXT NOT NULL, fee TEXT NOT NULL, execution_decision_id TEXT REFERENCES uta_risk_decisions(decision_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
                PRIMARY KEY(account_id,fill_id), FOREIGN KEY(account_id,order_id) REFERENCES uta_orders(account_id,order_id))

CREATE TABLE uta_liabilities (
                account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES uta_accounts(account_id), asset TEXT NOT NULL,
                principal TEXT NOT NULL, interest TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(account_id,asset))

CREATE TABLE uta_liquidation_accounts (
                account_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES uta_accounts(account_id),
                state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('NORMAL','LIQUIDATING','BANKRUPT','BLOCKED')),
                cycle INTEGER NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
                plan_market_version INTEGER, plan_position_digest TEXT)
CREATE TABLE uta_market (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), payload TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE uta_market_history (snapshot_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,content_digest TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,payload TEXT NOT NULL,origin TEXT NOT NULL,recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE uta_matches (
                    sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, trade_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                    symbol TEXT NOT NULL, buy_account_id TEXT NOT NULL, buy_order_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    buy_fill_id TEXT NOT NULL, sell_account_id TEXT NOT NULL, sell_order_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    sell_fill_id TEXT NOT NULL, buy_filled_before TEXT NOT NULL,
                    sell_filled_before TEXT NOT NULL, quantity TEXT NOT NULL, price TEXT NOT NULL,
                    market_version INTEGER NOT NULL, buy_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    sell_version INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    UNIQUE(buy_account_id,buy_fill_id), UNIQUE(sell_account_id,sell_fill_id),
                    FOREIGN KEY(buy_account_id,buy_fill_id) REFERENCES uta_fills(account_id,fill_id),
                    FOREIGN KEY(sell_account_id,sell_fill_id) REFERENCES uta_fills(account_id,fill_id))
CREATE TABLE uta_matching_schema (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),version INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE uta_orders (
                account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES uta_accounts(account_id), order_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                symbol TEXT NOT NULL, quantity TEXT NOT NULL, limit_price TEXT NOT NULL,
                reduce_only INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(reduce_only IN (0,1)),
                filled_quantity TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('OPEN','PARTIALLY_FILLED','FILLED','CANCELLED')),
                version INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, fee_notional TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', charged_fee TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', admission_decision_id TEXT REFERENCES uta_risk_decisions(decision_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
                PRIMARY KEY(account_id,order_id))

CREATE TABLE uta_positions (
                account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES uta_accounts(account_id), symbol TEXT NOT NULL,
                quantity TEXT NOT NULL, cost_basis TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY (account_id,symbol))

CREATE TABLE uta_risk_decisions (decision_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,kind TEXT NOT NULL,
                    account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES uta_accounts(account_id),business_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    market_snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES uta_market_history(snapshot_id),
                    artifact_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES uta_code_artifacts(artifact_id),
                    policy_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES uta_risk_policies(policy_id),pre_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    post_version INTEGER NOT NULL,recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,input_payload TEXT NOT NULL,
                    summary_payload TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(kind,account_id,business_id))
CREATE TABLE uta_risk_policies (policy_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,payload TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE uta_schema (version INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE uta_supervisor_schedule (
                singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), last_account TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE writer_fence_authority (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),format INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(format=1),authority_id TEXT NOT NULL,canonical_path TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE writer_fence_events (sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,kind TEXT NOT NULL,authority_id TEXT NOT NULL,owner_nonce TEXT,generation INTEGER NOT NULL,owner_pid INTEGER,boot_id TEXT NOT NULL,observed_ns INTEGER NOT NULL,expires_ns INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE writer_fence_guard_config(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),format INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(format=1))
CREATE TABLE writer_fence_guard_tables(name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,actions TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE writer_fence_lease (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation>=0),owner_nonce TEXT,owner_pid INTEGER,boot_id TEXT NOT NULL,expires_ns INTEGER NOT NULL,observed_ns INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_events_seal_only
        BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_events
        WHEN OLD.sealed != 0 OR NEW.sealed != 1 OR NEW.sequence != OLD.sequence
          OR NEW.event_id != OLD.event_id OR NEW.fingerprint != OLD.fingerprint
          OR NEW.previous_hash != OLD.previous_hash OR NEW.event_hash != OLD.event_hash
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'journal is immutable'); END
